newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board in moderate trade on late local buying interest in line with higher Japanese prices, brokers said on Tuesday.
Prices on the Tokyo and Kobe rubber markets ended higher as private investors accelerated efforts to cover short positions on the view that bumper Japanese rubber stocks will fall.
"The morning session was quiet and featureless despite some early firmness in Japan, but prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon on late buying interest," a local broker said.
"Some physical activity was noted for Thai RSS3's, mainly January, February and March," he said. The buyer was reported as a major tyre producer.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 rose half a cent to 127.00 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September rose one cent to 191.00 Singapore cents (US$1.36) a kg.
January TSR20 rose half a cent to 178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
